aiVerification.summary: The draft has usable source evidence but misgroups the jig validation conditions and omits key result rows.
issues: Changed factor may be new guide/yoke adhesion jig validation, not only Normal line vs JIG TEST.
JIG GAP condition and final 5/200 result are omitted.
Cross-date comparison of Normal line to 2024-04-17 JIG TEST is not clearly valid.
Measurement outcome from row 15 appears artificial and not supported by visible context.
Header/evidence citations are incomplete or weak.
requiredUserQuestions: Is Normal line the baseline for both JIG TEST dates?
Should JIG GAP be a separate changed condition in this same validation?
correctionPlan: Redefine changed factor around the new BP+SM guide/yoke adhesion jig test context.
Preserve date and type as subgroup keys when comparing rows.
Add JIG GAP row 20 and final conclusion row 21 to outcomes or limitations.
Remove unsupported measurement-stat outcome unless source row 15 is verified as valid data.
Use table headers from rows 13 and 16 plus all relevant data rows as evidence.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current row citations prove source existence but are not sufficient for final evidence grouping.
